description: US metropolitan and micropolitan statistical areas (CBSAs) — all 935. Of those only 393 are metropolitan; the rest are micropolitan and are NOT metro areas, so do not treat a CBSA count as a metro count. Each carries its divisions, parent combined area, land area and delivery footprint, plus the CMS Medicare labor market area, which is a DIFFERENT geography that shares the same code space. Filter by state to get every area in that state: without a filter only the first 25 are returned, alphabetically, so an unfiltered call answers with Aberdeen. Costs nothing and needs no key.

limit.description: Cap the number of areas returned. Defaults to 25 when no state is given, or to all areas in the state when one is.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code. Returns every area that includes that state — an area can span several, so it is matched against the area's whole state list. Omit to browse all states.
